result.title: A discrete-continuous-time stochastic framework for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder-related symptom modeling and pharmacological intervention via methylphenidate
result.summary: This paper presents an original mathematical and computational framework for modeling the efficacy of methylphenidate as an optimal control policy acting on the nonlinear dynamics of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder. Neural processes in ADHD are conceptualized as stochastic processes with trajectories that inherently converge towards stable, yet dysfunctional patterns associated with clinical symptoms. The pharmacological intervention is mathematically formalized as an external control signal that reassesses the system's drift and redirects these trajectories towards neurotypical regimes. To bridge these theoretical stochastic models with empirical clinical data, latent representations are inferred using a novel deterministic hybrid deep learning architecture, combining a one-dimensional convolutional neural network and a Vision Transformer, trained on preprocessed functional magnetic resonance imaging data.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 ADHD 症状动力学与哌甲酯药理干预建立离散-连续时间随机框架，并用 1D CNN 加 Vision Transformer 的混合网络从 fMRI 推断 latent 表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 属临床神经科学与最优控制领域，其中的 latent 只是从影像推断的观测编码，未涉及多模态推理状态的生成、使用与评价，也无可核查的具体借鉴线索。
